audit.summary: 17 PASS, 1 WARN, 1 FAIL; promotion BLOCKED by TAILS

checks.threshold: zero leakage violations; no VALIDATION log loss below 0.55 (implausible for single college games)
every row: known_at blank (never backdated), assumed_available_at = next day 06:00 UTC, pit = RETRO
no quarantined game scored or priced; conflict rate <= 2% per season (WARN above)
exactly one starter per team-game; projection top-1 accuracy >= 0.40 on SELECTION (WARN below)
reliever availability model: |mean p - mean y| <= 0.02 out of sample (2025)
R02 runs-scored violations <= 1% of eligible games; extra-inning scoring inconsistent with an automatic runner; run rule applied by measured context only
|CITL| per home conference within 3 standard errors + 0.01 (n >= 300)
|favourite p - observed| <= 0.025 in each tier with n >= 500
first three weeks: calibration slope >= 0.80 (not overconfident), |CITL| <= 0.03
single-source games no worse than verified games by > 0.03 log loss (n >= 200)
programs with |z| > 3.5 no more than chance (~0.05% each)
chosen model's SELECTION->VALIDATION log-loss gap no worse than the best baseline's by > 0.005; <= 3 holdout looks per family; tuned values on a grid edge WARN
P(total >= 20), P(side >= 15), P(shutout) within max(0.01, 15% relative) of observed on VALIDATION; 80% total interval covers 77-83% (WARN outside)

full-game prices from the engine that is not worse on the moneyline, totals or run line (closed form vs simulator, VALIDATION); first-five Monte Carlo SE <= 0.01 at the board's draw count; zero incoherent prices in the study and on the board
in season: warehouse rebuilt within 2 days (FAIL); off season: within 30 days (WARN)
the chosen model must not trail the best baseline in the two latest non-holdout seasons (FAIL) or in more than two seasons (WARN)
stacking weights move by <= 0.6 between season blocks (FAIL if the ensemble is adopted and unstable)
the experiment registry hash chain is intact
